errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени по низходящ ред на големината им, започвайки от най-големия.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are visually arranged in descending order of size, but this is not true. The sectors are not sorted by size on the pie chart itself.

errors.text_span: като са леко изнесени от равнината на кръга.
errors.evidence: The phrase 'леко изнесени от равнината на кръга' (slightly moved out of the plane of the circle) is an ambiguous way to describe the 3D effect of the chart, as it can be misinterpreted as the slices being exploded. A later sentence contradicts this possibility, creating confusion.
